data.one_liner: Base32 encoder and decoder for Dart, supporting multiple variants and OTP secrets.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple base32 encoding and decoding conforming to RFC4648. It handles byte lists, hex strings, and plain strings, as well as multiple variants such as base32Hex, crockford, z-base-32, and geohash.
use_when: You need to encode or decode Base32 strings for One Time Password (OTP) secrets.
You are working with RFC4648 Base32 or its variants like Crockford or Geohash.
avoid_when: You need standard Base64 encoding instead of Base32.
strengths: Supports multiple variants including base32Hex, crockford, z-base-32, and geohash.
Provides helper methods for encoding and decoding hex and plain strings directly.
